evidence.evidence_text: In the rapidly evolving field of conversational AI, Ontology Expansion (OnExp) is crucial for enhancing the adaptability and robustness of conversational agents.
This survey paper provides a comprehensive review of the state-of-the-art techniques in OnExp for conversational understanding.
